consequence.statement: A new API kind is now served. Existing resources and settings are unaffected. Operators who manage CRDs separately should install the new CRD with the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: If you manage CRDs separately from the release, install or update them before upgrading.

assertion.statement: The target release's install bundle adds the new CRD externalartifacts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, which serves ExternalArtifact at source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1.

checks.detail: a newly added subject has no consequence for existing environments
